key_insight: DeepDOSReasoner predicts electronic and phonon density-of-states spectra from atomic structures while preserving nonnegativity and total-state conservation.
engineering_relevance: Millisecond-scale spectral predictions could accelerate materials screening, including photovoltaic chalcogenides, but do not directly establish solar-cell performance.
method: Decode spectra using atom-to-energy source attention.
Refine normalized spectra with learned continuity-equation transport.
Enforce nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports the best accuracy across all evaluated metrics for both spectrum types and DFT confirmation of valence-band gaps in 25 of the top 50 candidates from a prospective screen of 8,106 materials.
watch_item: Predicted valence-band gaps are screening signals, not proof of photovoltaic efficiency or device viability.
paper_title: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
